description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for managing share dividend payouts within the Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for retrieving, creating, updating (approving), and deleting dividend payout records related to share products. It utilizes JAX-RS annotations for defining REST endpoints, employs dependency injection, and integrates with platform security and command processing services.

classes.name: ShareDividendApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing share dividend payouts, including retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting dividend payout records related to share products.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all dividend payout records for a specific share product, with optional pagination and sorting.

methods.name: retrieveDividendDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed dividend payout information for a specific dividend ID, including account details.

methods.name: createDividendDetail
methods.description: Creates a new share product dividend payout record based on the provided JSON request body.

methods.name: updateDividendDetail
methods.description: Updates an existing dividend payout record, such as approving it, based on commands and provided JSON body.

methods.name: deleteDividendDetail
methods.description: Deletes a specified dividend payout record.
